findings.title: Required GitHub Actions CI Completely Omits AI Platform Subsystem (`tests/ai`)
findings.observed:
The primary GitHub Actions workflow `.github/workflows/remediation-ci.yml:125-126` specifies pytest testpaths that completely exclude `tests/ai/`:
  `pytest ... tests/core tests/gates tests/generators tests/validators tests/architecture tests/contracts tests/fault_injection tests/e2e/test_pipeline_integration.py`.
  None of the 270 test files in `tests/ai/` are executed in CI.
findings.expected: All production-bound subsystems must be verified in required CI gates before merging to `main`.
findings.production_impact: Any breaking changes, regressions, or syntax errors in the entire AI platform can be merged without failing CI.
findings.remediation_direction: Add `tests/ai` or create a dedicated `ai-tests` workflow job in `.github/workflows/`.

findings.title: Local CI Runner Script Diverges Structurally from GitHub Actions CI
findings.observed: `scripts/ci/run_required_checks.sh` diverges from `.github/workflows/remediation-ci.yml` in 6 distinct ways: (1) runs `tests/ai` instead of `tests/fault_injection`, (2) runs contract generation drift checks, (3) omits Ruff linter, (4) omits Trivy vulnerability scanner, (5) scans different directories with Bandit, and (6) skips Docker hermetic build and acceptance tests.
findings.expected: Local check scripts must faithfully replicate the required GitHub Actions CI gates.
findings.production_impact: Passing checks locally gives false confidence that pull requests will pass CI, and vice versa.
findings.remediation_direction: Harmonize `run_required_checks.sh` to execute the exact commands and flags used in `remediation-ci.yml`.

findings.title: Production Run Execution Path Disconnected from AI Platform
findings.observed: The production video execution path (`POST /projects/{id}/runs` $\to$ `worker.py` $\to$ `pipeline.py`) contains zero calls to `ai/`, `CreativePlanner`, `NarrativePlanner`, or external LLMs. It requires pre-existing `master_plan.md` and `05_blueprint.json` on disk and executes only deterministic gates and Remotion rendering.
findings.expected: End-to-end automated video generation should translate user requests to video via Creative Intelligence.
findings.production_impact: The AI platform is completely unreachable from the live SaaS video generation queue.
findings.remediation_direction: Design a unified run workflow that triggers `CreativePlanner` when `master_plan.md` is absent.

findings.title: Production API Lacks Natural-Language Video Generation Intake Endpoint
findings.observed: None of the 34 API endpoints mounted in `api/main.py:57-70` accept natural-language briefs, prompts, or generative instructions. All routes require pre-existing IDs, pre-authored assets, or typed mutation payloads.
findings.expected: A modern AI video production platform should expose a route (e.g. `POST /projects/generate` or `POST /brief`) accepting natural language.
findings.evidence: `api/main.py:57-70`; grep across `api/routers/` for prompt/brief parameters yields 0 results.
findings.production_impact: External clients and frontends cannot prompt the system for autonomous video creation.
findings.remediation_direction: Implement a `POST /projects/generate` endpoint wired to `CreativePlanner`.

findings.title: `/intent` Endpoint Operates Exclusively on Strongly Typed AST Mutations
findings.observed: `POST /projects/{project_id}/intent` rejects freeform text. It strictly validates payloads against Zod `AuthoringRequestSchema` / `AuthoringIntentSchema` (a discriminated union of 14 typed intents like `UPDATE_TEXT`, `REPLACE_MEDIA`) and delegates to deterministic TypeScript `IntentPlanner`.
findings.expected: Documentation and developer intuition imply `/intent` accepts natural-language edit requests.
findings.production_impact: Clients sending raw natural language receive HTTP 422 / Zod validation errors.
findings.remediation_direction: Introduce an NL-to-AuthoringIntent translation service before dispatching to `IntentPlanner`.

findings.title: `ContextBuilder` Has Zero Production Callers
findings.observed: `ai/context/builder.py:47-91` implements `ContextBuilder`. Grep across `api/` and `scripts/` confirms zero imports or instantiations. It is called exclusively within `tests/ai/context/`.
findings.expected: ContextBuilder should assemble prompt context for AI planners during request processing.
findings.production_impact: Context budgeting, compression, and ranking logic are completely unused in production.
findings.remediation_direction: Wire `ContextBuilder` into the planned AI generation entrypoint.

findings.title: Broken Context Dependency Injection (`KnowledgeRouter` Not Injected)
findings.observed: `ContextBuilder.__init__` accepts `knowledge_retriever: Optional[KnowledgeRetriever]`, defaulting to `DeterministicKnowledgeRetriever()`. `KnowledgeRouter` does not implement this protocol and is never injected into `ContextBuilder` anywhere in the repository.
findings.expected: Context assembly should retrieve domain knowledge through `KnowledgeRouter`.
findings.production_impact: `ContextBuilder` can only retrieve hardcoded or deterministic mock knowledge.
findings.remediation_direction: Implement an adapter bridging `KnowledgeRouter` to `KnowledgeRetriever` protocol.

findings.title: Catalog Initialization Never Invoked in Production Runtime
findings.observed: `initialize_canonical_catalog()` in `ai/knowledge/router.py:58-68` is never called during FastAPI startup lifespan (`api/main.py:28-40`), worker initialization, or pipeline execution. It is invoked only in test/eval runners.
findings.expected: The knowledge catalog should be initialized and indexed at application boot.
findings.production_impact: Knowledge indexer remains unpopulated in long-running services.
findings.remediation_direction: Add catalog initialization to FastAPI lifespan startup.

findings.title: Root `ground-truth/` Functions as Derivative Documentation
findings.observed: Root `ground-truth/` contains 13 auto-generated JSON and Markdown files produced by `scripts/generators/build_ground_truth.py`. It is not an ML evaluation dataset or runtime authority.
findings.expected: System authority should reside in canonical typed registries, with documentation clearly classified.
findings.production_impact: Creates confusion about whether `ground-truth/` is an ML training set, runtime config, or documentation index.
findings.remediation_direction: Relocate `ground-truth/` into `documentation/indexes/` or `registry/generated/`.

findings.title: Zero Production Runtime Consumers for Files in Root `ground-truth/`
findings.observed: Neither `api/` nor `scripts/pipeline.py` imports or reads files from `ground-truth/`. Only offline test runners and legacy plugin tools read them.
findings.expected: Unconsumed artifacts should not gate production CI.
findings.production_impact: CI enforces strict hash synchronization for files that no production process reads.
findings.remediation_direction: Relax CI gating on derivative indexes once documentation is updated.

findings.title: `template_catalog.json` Operates as a Derivative Metadata Index
findings.observed: `ground-truth/template_catalog.json` is a derivative compatibility catalog generated from `registry/template-registry.tsx`. The true single source of truth is `registry/template-registry-data.json`.
findings.expected: One canonical authority for template metadata.
findings.production_impact: Developers and agents frequently edit or cite `template_catalog.json` believing it is the authority.
findings.remediation_direction: Clarify authority in `AGENTS.md` and deprecate `template_catalog.json`.

findings.title: `RecipeRegistry` Globs and Migrates `recipes/*.json` on Boot in Memory
findings.observed: `RecipeRegistry.__init__` with default `auto_load=True` globs all 18 JSON files in `recipes/` (skipping `schema.json`), migrates legacy provider keys, and registers them in memory.
findings.expected: Recipes should be validated against static schema contracts without dynamic in-memory migration overhead.
findings.production_impact: Minor boot latency; runtime relies on on-the-fly migration rather than migrated source files.
findings.remediation_direction: Migrate `recipes/*.json` files permanently on disk to conform to modern schema.

findings.title: Skills Subsystem Employs Dual-Loading Architecture
findings.observed: `SkillLoader` supports both typed Python definitions (`get_canonical_skills()`) and dynamic markdown parsing (`load_from_markdown()` for `SKILL.md` files).
findings.expected: Consistent skill loading mechanism across agents and platform.
findings.production_impact: Potential discrepancy between canonical typed skills and agent-authored markdown skills.
findings.remediation_direction: Maintain dual-loading but enforce strict contract schema validation on markdown imports.

findings.title: Internal Product AI Strictly Forbids Raw MCP Invocations
findings.observed: AST architecture guards in `tests/ai/audit/test_s28_m11_final_architecture_audit.py` strictly forbid raw MCP calls from internal code. All capabilities must route through `CapabilityRouter` and `ToolGateway` via native Python adapters.
findings.expected: Strongly typed, safe in-process capability execution with FastMCP as an external boundary only.
findings.production_impact: High performance and type safety for internal capabilities; eliminates JSON-RPC serialization overhead.
findings.remediation_direction: Update `.agents/AGENTS.md` and `ROUTER.md` to reflect that raw MCP is banned internally.

findings.title: `CapabilityRouter` and `ToolGateway` Have Zero Production Call Sites
findings.observed: Despite 32 fully modeled capabilities and a 15-stage tool execution pipeline, neither `api/main.py` nor `scripts/pipeline.py` imports or invokes `CapabilityRouter` or `ToolGateway`.
findings.expected: Production tasks requiring speech, vision, or image generation should dispatch through `CapabilityRouter`.
findings.production_impact: The entire S28-M tool modernization effort is isolated from production users.
findings.remediation_direction: Wire `CapabilityRouter` into the planned AI video generation pipeline.

findings.title: `CreativePlanCompiler` Disconnected from Production Authoring Path
findings.observed: `BlueprintCompiler` in `ai/planning/compiler.py:62-443` is the sole translator from `CreativePlan` to canonical `BlueprintV2` / `VideoDocument`. It has zero callers in `api/` or `authoring/`. Production authoring creates or edits documents via manual AST mutations.
findings.expected: The creative planning output must compile into canonical `VideoDocument` for authoring and rendering.
findings.evidence: `ai/planning/compiler.py:62-443`; grep for callers outside tests yields 0 results.
findings.production_impact: A `CreativePlan` cannot be turned into an editable video document in production.
findings.remediation_direction: Expose a production service calling `BlueprintCompiler` to initialize authoring sessions.

findings.title: Remotion Dual Reality (Contractual Adapter vs. Operational Authority)
findings.observed: While contracts (`contracts/renderer.ts`) and RenderPlanner define Remotion as an engine-neutral adapter, all 105 canonical templates are React TSX components importing Remotion hooks, `scripts/gates/probe_qc.py` invokes `remotion still`, and `scripts/render_project.py` falls back to `npx remotion render`.
findings.expected: True renderer independence allowing interchangeable rendering via Canvas or Remotion.
findings.production_impact: Complete lock-in to Node.js and Remotion runtime for production video generation.
findings.remediation_direction: Decouple template definitions from React hooks or build Canvas adapter template equivalents.

findings.title: Test Reality Divergence in Suites Named "E2E"
findings.observed: Tests named "E2E" do not enter through full unmocked production paths: AI E2E tests chain in-memory classes; `true_e2e_suite.py` bypasses the API and worker daemon by invoking the CLI directly on disk fixtures; multi-tenant SaaS tests mock worker polling.
findings.expected: True product E2E tests should send an HTTP request to `api/`, wait for background worker polling, render the video, and verify HTTP output streaming.
findings.production_impact: Automated tests verify isolated components but leave the full user-to-video delivery journey unverified.
findings.remediation_direction: Author a true product E2E suite that drives the entire stack via HTTP $\to$ Worker $\to$ Video Stream.

findings.title: Development/Testing Identity Spoofing and Unauthenticated Auth Fallback
findings.observed: In `api/core/auth.py:240-305`, when `MOTION_ENV != "production"`, callers can pass hardcoded tokens (`admin`, `system`) or unverified headers (`X-Principal-ID: root`, `X-Principal-Roles: admin`) to gain full global administrative privileges without authentication.
findings.expected: Cryptographic authentication enforced uniformly, with dev keys for local environments.
findings.production_impact: If `MOTION_ENV=production` is omitted in any deployment, administrative auth is completely bypassed.
findings.remediation_direction: Remove token string heuristics and unverified header parsing from `auth.py`.

findings.title: Disconnect Between Multi-Tenant SQL Model and Flat Filesystem Workspaces
findings.observed: `TenantRepository` enforces workspace isolation in SQL, and `StorageService` partitions object keys by workspace ID, but on the local filesystem, projects reside in a flat directory `projects/{project_id}/`.
findings.expected: Filesystem workspaces should be partitioned by tenant (`projects/{workspace_id}/{project_id}/`).
findings.production_impact: Local scripts or file leaks can access projects across tenant boundaries.
findings.remediation_direction: Migrate local filesystem workspaces to `projects/{workspace_id}/{project_id}`.

findings.title: Agent Directive Drift in `.agents/AGENTS.md` and `references/ROUTER.md`
findings.observed: Agent instructions prescribe ungrounded rules (e.g. 480-490 plan line count limit), mandate raw MCP servers that are banned by AST guards, cite excluded engine bridges, and recommend quarantined tools.
findings.expected: Agent rules must strictly mirror active runtime constraints and modern architectural patterns.
findings.production_impact: Orchestrator agents generate brittle plans, invoke obsolete tools, and fail security gates.
findings.remediation_direction: Rewrite `AGENTS.md` and `ROUTER.md` to align with S28-M and S28-R.

findings.title: Lingering Historical Migration & Deprecated Scripts in `scripts/archive/`
findings.observed: `scripts/archive/` contains 28 unconsumed files across `phase13/`, `phase14/`, `phase15/`, `phase16/` and legacy smoke scripts, alongside partially consumed migration scripts (`migrate_legacy_projects.py`).
findings.expected: Clean codebase free of unconsumed migration scrap.
findings.production_impact: Increases repository noise and cognitive overhead during architecture audits.
findings.remediation_direction: Delete proven 0-consumer files and retire tests that import archived scripts.

findings.title: Vitest Remotion CI Exclusion (36 S28-R Test Files Unexecuted)
findings.observed: In `.github/workflows/remediation-ci.yml:58`, CI runs `npm run test` in root. In `package.json:28`, `npm run test` executes only 13 test files. 36 Remotion test files in `tests/remotion/` (including all S28-R adapter, graph, and compositor tests) are omitted from the test runner.
findings.expected: All TypeScript unit and contract tests should be executed in required CI.
findings.production_impact: Regressions in S28-R renderer adapters or compositor logic are not caught by CI.
findings.remediation_direction: Update root `package.json` test script to include `tests/remotion/**/*.test.ts`.

findings.title: Zod Dependency Split Across Monorepo Roots
findings.observed: Root `package.json:48` pins `zod: 3.25.76`. In contrast, `remotion-app/package.json:33,43` pins `zod: 4.5.4` with an override block (`overrides: { "zod": "4.5.4" }`).
findings.expected: Consistent dependency versions across workspaces in the repository.
findings.production_impact: Potential schema validation divergence or runtime incompatibility when contracts cross boundaries.
findings.remediation_direction: Align Zod version across root and `remotion-app`.
